en:
The hell do you want!? Why the fuck would
I hang out with a small fry like you!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Miu for a while?
Even though it might not be safe to ask...

Eh!? Small fries like you should be salted
and eaten!

But...I guess I'll hang out with you since
you had the balls to ask!

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
